calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY p.category, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY p.category, d.fiscal_year

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_net,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returns_net,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS net_sales_after_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY p.category, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY p.category, d.fiscal_year

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as row_count,
  SUM(net_sales_before_returns) as total_before,
  SUM(returns_net) as total_returns,
  SUM(net_sales) as total_after
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-11-25' AND '2024-12-22'

SELECT 
  p.category,
  d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) as staff_purchases,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as staff_purchase_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as total_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY p.category, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY p.category, d.fiscal_year

calls.statement:
WITH category_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_before_returns,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY p.category, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN sales_before_returns - returns_net ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN sales_before_returns - returns_net ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN sales_before_returns - returns_net ELSE 0 END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN sales_before_returns - returns_net ELSE 0 END)) / 
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN sales_before_returns - returns_net ELSE 0 END) * 100,
    2
  ) AS growth_pct
FROM category_sales
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
